title: start warns of an item that waits on a trigger or a host the sprint cannot reach
goal: backlog.py start warns, naming each, of a sprint item (or a task under it) that waits on an unfired trigger or names a host other than the one starting the sprint in its trigger, so the operator moves it out or accepts that the review waits on it; a test plants an item with an unfired trigger. Answers the SP-w3xmbdra retrospective: four items waiting on a Claude Code release or the Windows host held the sprint's review until they were moved out.

run: import json,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib;t=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());b=t/'kb'/'_self'/'backlog';shutil.copytree('kb/_self/backlog',b);w=lambda d:json.dump(d,open(b/(d['id']+'.json'),'w',encoding='utf-8'));w({'id':'SP-planted00','kind':'sprint','title':'planted','status':'planned','goal':'planted trigger warning','gates':[{'id':'start','kind':'blocking','question':'Approve?','options':['approve','change','cancel'],'recommendation':'approve','answer':'approve','by':'operator'}]});w({'id':'ST-planted00','kind':'story','title':'planted trigger','status':'todo','sprint':'SP-planted00','priority':'P3','goal':'planted','touches':['kb/_self/backlog.md'],'checks':[{'run':['python3','_tools/backlog.py','check']}],'trigger':{'when':'a Claude session on a host this sprint cannot reach','fired':False}});w({'id':'ST-planted01','kind':'story','title':'Review sprint: planted','review':True,'status':'todo','sprint':'SP-planted00','priority':'P1','goal':'review','checks':[{'run':['python3','_tools/backlog.py','check']}]});o=subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/backlog.py','--root',str(t),'start','SP-planted00'],capture_output=True,text=True);out=o.stdout+o.stderr;sys.exit(0 if 'ST-planted00' in out and 'trigger' in out else 1)

notes: Housekeeping 2026-10-06: the -k start_warns_unreachable_trigger selector named a test the suite rules no longer allow; the check copies the backlog to a temporary root, plants an approved sprint with a story whose trigger is unfired, runs backlog.py --root T start on it and expects the warning to name the story and its trigger.
